prose.en: OUT OF ORDER for a machine that is not working, e.g. public phone or washing machine
NO VACANCIES in the window of a B&B (cheap hotel), it means the hotel is full
SOLD OUT outside a cinema or concert hall – there are no tickets left; they have all been sold
PLEASE QUEUE OTHER SIDE (= wait in a line on the other side of this notice) e.g. in a bank or post office
KEEP RIGHT (= stay on the right side, and continue on the right side) e.g. in airports, on the underground
D Be careful! With these notices, something bad may happen if you do not pay attention to them.
MIND YOUR HEAD (= be careful you don't hit your head) e.g. in front of a low door
MIND THE STEP (= be careful you don't hit the step and fall) e.g. in front of a step
FRAGILE (= be careful, this will break easily)
BEWARE OF PICKPOCKETS (= be careful, there are people here who will steal things from your bag or pocket without you knowing)

note: Left page has explanatory definition sentences under the notice diagrams (sections A, B, D); right page is exercises only.
